changes.reason: The standalone Node listener forwards buffered response bytes without a UTF-8 decode/encode round trip. SSE streaming, request lifetime, headers and the Fetch handler retain their existing paths.

kubernetes.reason: The existing Node listener preserves Yoga response-plugin gzip bytes over an actual local Node HTTP connection.
constraints: Local Node host execution only; no Kubernetes cluster deployment or provider certification is claimed.
Ordinary responses remain buffered; SSE retains its existing streaming and backpressure path.

evidence.testName: GraphQL Node response bytes preserves 'gzip' bytes produced by a Yoga response plugin

aws-lambda.reason: This change affects GraphQLServer.start and its Node HTTP listener only. Lambda invocation adapters consume the existing Fetch response path, which is unchanged.
constraints: No Lambda invocation or deployment claim is added.

cloudflare.reason: Workers consume the separate Fetch entrypoint rather than starting a Node listener. No Worker response serialization or runtime capability changes.
constraints: No Workers or Node Container deployment claim is added.
